answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to forge a bonded stake that is locked for weeks before it can trade. Reputation then accrues only through completed, peer-attested work, so a fresh island of fake accounts starts with zero trust and cannot whisper its way into deals. Creating a thousand sock puppets means locking a thousand stakes and doing a thousand real jobs first, which costs far more than any single scam can return.
